# data.docker_swarm

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads the swarm the provider's Docker host manages (`GET /swarm`): ID, spec, join tokens, root CA and data path port. The host must be a manager. `inspect` holds the whole Engine swarm object; the join tokens are sensitive (`join_tokens`, `worker_join_token`, `manager_join_token`), so prefer the `docker_swarm_tokens` ephemeral resource when they only feed other ephemeral values.
